command:
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
as_root() {
  if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
    "$@"
  else
    sudo -n "$@"
  fi
}
as_root install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /srv/inventory/data
printf '%s\n' 'sku-1001,keyboard,12' 'sku-1002,display,7' | as_root tee /srv/inventory/data/records.csv > /dev/null
printf '%s\n' '{"site":"north","generation":4}' | as_root tee /srv/inventory/data/config.json > /dev/null
as_root chown -R root:root /srv/inventory
as_root chmod 0755 /srv/inventory /srv/inventory/data
as_root chmod 0644 /srv/inventory/data/records.csv /srv/inventory/data/config.json
